name: BPURI
recent: Bina Puri 在 2026 财年首季（截至 8 月 31 日）录得 RM6,758 万净利，主要来自一次性收益；营收同比下滑 49.6%。公司宣布董事部变动，Matthew Tee Kai Woon 辞去执行董事职务，并发布第 34 届常年股东大会通知。此外，公司披露了清盘/接管相关公告，并签署了一份谅解备忘录。
notable: 公布 2026 财年首季净利 RM6,758 万，主要来自一次性收益。
执行董事 Matthew Tee Kai Woon 辞任。
risks: 公司披露清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人相关公告。
earnings: 2026 财年首季（截至 8 月 31 日）营收为 RM3,159 万，环比下降 10.3%，同比下降 49.6%；净利为 RM6,758 万，净利率 213.9%，去年同期净利率为 -26.6%。

recent_en: Bina Puri reported a net profit of RM67.58 million for 1QFY2026 ended 31 Aug 2026, mainly driven by one-off gains, while revenue fell 49.6% year-on-year. The company announced boardroom changes with Matthew Tee Kai Woon resigning as Executive Director, and issued notice of its 34th AGM. It also disclosed winding-up/receivership related announcements and entered into a memorandum of understanding.
notable_en: Reported 1QFY2026 net profit of RM67.58 million, mainly from one-off gains.
Entered into a memorandum of understanding.
Executive Director Matthew Tee Kai Woon resigned.
risks_en: The company disclosed winding-up/receiver & manager/restraining order/special administrator related announcements.
earnings_en: 1QFY2026 ended 31 Aug 2026 revenue was RM31.59 million, down 10.3% QoQ and 49.6% YoY; net profit was RM67.58 million with a net margin of 213.9%, compared to -26.6% in the prior-year period.
